text:
What the mouse should do seeing you, you do seeing it, fleeing and screaming, though you are a mousetrap in cleanliness and traps.


Who saw you flee would judge you aged cheese, for wrinkles make you look like cheese.


Who thought mice eat the white poison heaped on your face?


Why leap walls fleeing, when mice will not gnaw your dirty wool complexion?

translation.title: To an Ugly Woman Afraid of Mice
